global_guidelines.objective: Extract one ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 view, in the SEI Views and Beyond sense, for the stakeholder task already selected. Ground every element in the scoped source files. Do not write a full architecture document, C4 model, or arc42 template.
output: Return ViewModel JSON only: elements, relations, groups, unanswered, notes.
Do not write markdown sections or PlantUML. A later stage renders the diagram.
coverage: Publish the smallest set of elements that answers the architectural questions and required_information.
Do not list every class, file, or container in the repository.
Concerns this viewpoint does not frame belong in unanswered, not as extra boxes.
naming: Name each box by the responsibility it owns, and ground it to one file in the scope.
Never name a box Boundary, Entity, DTO, Controller, Database, a Java package segment, or a parent-folder name.
grounding: Use only the scoped SOURCE FILES.
Do not invent actors, types, nodes, protocols, or relations that those files do not show.
evidence.file must be a path in SOURCE FILES. support is observed when the excerpt shows the claim, otherwise inferred.
If a required_information id cannot be grounded, put it in unanswered.

context.title: Architectural Context
mapping_rules: Draw actors only when code, config, or docs represent a user or external role.
Draw exactly one system box. Name it with the product or system name, not a package, folder, or GUI class.
External systems and datastores sit outside that box, and only when an interface, client, or store is evidenced.
Relations are actor-to-system or system-to-external. Do not expand internal use cases into separate boxes.
Do not invent actors, externals, or relations absent from the repository.
forbidden_inferences: internal classes, GUIs, or packages used as the system name
a use-case inventory in place of the system box

cnc-runtime.title: Containers
mapping_rules: Identify runtime components from services, applications, databases, or brokers evidenced in code or infrastructure files.
Name each component by its runtime responsibility. A source package or folder is not a runtime node.
External systems stay outside the system and only when evidenced.
Label a connector with a protocol (HTTP, gRPC, SQL, AMQP) only when that protocol is evidenced.
Show a provided or required interface only when code or config declares it.
Do not invent nodes, interfaces, or relationships that are not present in the repository.
forbidden_inferences: source packages drawn as runtime nodes
protocols or topics not declared in code or config

module-decomposition.title: Components
mapping_rules: Publish 5 to 12 modules that own the task, named by responsibility (the type that owns the behaviour, not the folder).
Relations are contains or uses, and only when one scoped file references another.
Do not draw one box per source file and do not publish a class inventory.
Do not use folder or package names (boundary, controller, dto, entity) as module names.
Ground each module to one implementing file in the scope.

code-mapping.title: Code-Level View
mapping_rules: Include only types that implement the task, each mapped to its source file.
Inheritance only when extends or implements is explicit in code.
Associations only when a field, parameter, or return type shows the link. Bidirectional only when both directions are explicit.
Multiplicity only when a collection, optional, or non-null constraint shows it. If uncertain, omit it.
Do not group types into packages that mirror directories.
Do not stereotype boxes as entity, dto, or controller.
Do not dump every type in the repository.
forbidden_inferences: package boxes and entity, dto, or controller stereotypes

allocation-deployment.title: Deployment View
mapping_rules: Nodes come from Docker, compose, Kubernetes, or host declarations in the repository.
Artifacts come from images or build outputs those files name.
Datastores come from compose services, SQL, or configuration that names a database.
Execution environment (OS, runtime, middleware) only when a file states it.
Communication paths and ports only when a manifest or config declares them.
If deployment evidence is missing, leave the need unanswered. Do not invent a second node to fill the diagram.
Do not draw classes or Java packages as deployment nodes.
forbidden_inferences: cloud providers or regions not stated
network topologies beyond what is declared
a placeholder app-plus-database pair when no deploy file exists

decision-record.title: Quality Attributes and Rationale
mapping_rules: Record a quality attribute or rationale only when a comment, document, or structural choice in the repo states it.
Name the components that decision affects, grounded to files.
Relations are depends, and only between those components.
Do not invent architecture decision records, quality goals, or tradeoffs the repository does not state.
forbidden_inferences: decisions not written in comments, docs, or structure
quality attributes inferred only from the stakeholder goal
